description: Evals for ai-act-review — verifies triggering accuracy and functional behavior across review modes and risk levels

evals.description: Direct trigger using the canonical command phrase

evals.prompt: Check AI compliance for our recommendation engine
What's the AI risk level for our credit scoring feature?
evals.description: Trigger via risk assessment question about an AI feature

evals.prompt: Review the chatbot spec against EU AI regulations
Check GDPR compliance of the user profile
Benchmark the brief for our ML pipeline
evals.description: Should trigger brief-to-benchmark, not ai-act-review — user wants competitive research

evals.prompt: AI Act review on the product recommendation brief at docs/features/product-recommendations/BRIEF.md
evals.description: Given a BRIEF mentioning a recommendation engine, does the agent detect AI and provide preliminary risk classification?
expected_behavior: Detects BRIEF artifact type and enters Triage mode
Identifies recommendation engine as AI component
Classifies as limited risk (Art. 50 transparency)
Produces Recommendations for SPEC
Passes validate-ai-act-review.sh

evals.prompt: Run AI Act compliance review on the credit scoring spec at docs/features/credit-scoring/SPEC.md
evals.description: Given a SPEC with automated credit scoring, does the agent classify as high-risk and perform full compliance assessment?
expected_behavior: Detects SPEC artifact type and enters Deep mode
Classifies as high-risk (Annex III, category 5: essential services)
Assesses transparency requirements (Art. 13)
Assesses human oversight (Art. 14)
Assesses data governance (Art. 10)
Determines conformity assessment type
Produces compliance ACs in Given/When/Then format
Cites AI Act articles

evals.prompt: Check AI Act compliance of the chatbot design at docs/features/customer-chatbot/DESIGN.md
evals.description: Given a chatbot DESIGN, does the agent check for transparency UI elements?
expected_behavior: Detects DESIGN artifact type and enters Verify mode
Checks for AI interaction disclosure indicator
Checks for human escalation controls
Produces gap report for missing transparency elements

evals.prompt: AI Act review on the fraud detection spec
evals.description: Does the agent confirm each section with the user before moving on?
expected_behavior: Proposes AI System Inventory and waits for confirmation
Proposes Risk Classification and waits for confirmation
Does NOT output the full review without intermediate confirmations

evals.prompt: Revue AI Act sur le spec du moteur de recommandation
evals.description: If the conversation is in French, is the review still written in English?
expected_behavior: Writes AI-ACT-REVIEW.md entirely in English
